# Fixtures

Model directories are unchanged files from [KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/2bac6f8c57bf471df0d2a1e8a8ec023c7801dddf/Models) at `2bac6f8c`, each with its `LICENSE.md`. `default-sampler.gltf` derives from BoxTextured under its license; `required-draco.gltf` and `required-meshopt.gltf` are this package's, MIT.
